description: Drag one element onto another — reordering rows, moving a card between columns, resizing a split. Dispatches a real press, several intermediate moves and a release, because drag implementations almost always ignore a press followed immediately by a release somewhere else.

frame.description: 'main' (default) or a substring of a frame's origin/name.

selector.description: CSS selector for what to drag.

steps.description: Intermediate move events. More is slower but survives pickier drag handlers.

testid.description: Test id of what to drag.

text.description: Visible text of what to drag.

timeout_ms.description: How long to wait for either element to become actionable.

to_selector.description: CSS selector for where to drop it.

to_testid.description: Test id of where to drop it.

to_text.description: Visible text of where to drop it.

name: ui_drag
